review.explanation: The mention surface is 樂廣, which directly matches the candidate's canonical name 樂廣. The supporting evidence sfh1-ev-23-rendan-013-liu-annotation-003 contains '樂廣譏之曰' explicitly naming 樂廣 in the Liu annotation text, and the candidate evidence sfh1-candidate-evidence-736284c319cd149ef9d0 from data/people.json also records 樂廣. The annotation context discusses 樂廣 criticizing the unrestrained behavior of the bamboo grove figures, which is consistent with the historical figure 樂廣. Direct name match with explicit textual evidence supports the identity.

The mention surface is 樂令, an office title reference (令 = Prefect/Ling) for 樂廣. The reference semantics explicitly states this corefers with sfh1-mention-89cb2b7e4aab45504bd6c536 (樂廣), and the annotation text sfh1-ev-23-rendan-013-liu-annotation-004 contains '此樂令之言' which refers back to 樂廣's words quoted in annotation 003 ('樂廣譏之曰'). The candidate evidence sfh1-candidate-evidence-036c8e76aba0048a8e2c from data/people.json records 樂廣. The office title 樂令 is a well-attested way of referring to 樂廣, who served as a 令 (prefect). The coreference chain from 樂令 to 樂廣 in the same annotation passage is explicit and supported by the supplied evidence.
